# ManYue reading and library learning path

> Import local comics and prepare offline reading, then organise shelves, adjust reading settings and connect NAS libraries, servers and sync.

## App and version

- [ManYue: local comics, offline reading and NAS libraries](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/manyue/index.md): Learn about ManYue comic imports, offline reading, WebDAV, SMB and personal comic servers, then choose a tutorial for your library.
Version listed: 2.0.2; checked 2026-10-22; iOS 15.0+ / iPadOS 15.0+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. ManYue getting started: import local comics and read offline](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-getting-started/index.md): Start with your own CBZ, CBR or PDF to learn local comic import, shelf selection, offline reading and common issues in ManYue. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [2. ManYue file formats: choose CBZ, CBR, CB7 or PDF and check page order](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-formats-and-page-order/index.md): Distinguish comic archives, PDFs and image folders, organise filenames and chapter structure, then check the cover, page count and spreads after importing. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [3. Import image folders into ManYue: one book or separate chapters](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-image-folder-import/index.md): Choose the correct folder level for a single image book, chapter folders or multiple comic files, avoiding missed imports and incorrect grouping from mixed structures. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [4. Troubleshoot ManYue imports: file access, formats and folder levels](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-import-troubleshooting/index.md): Distinguish files not downloaded, format mismatches, mixed folders, insufficient storage and partial failures, using a small sample you can test repeatedly. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [5. Organise ManYue shelves: to read, reading and finished](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-bookshelf-organization/index.md): Create a few stable shelf groups, distinguish moving, copying, removing from a group and deleting a comic, then verify the result with samples. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [6. ManYue reading layouts: direction, single pages, double pages and spreads](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-reading-layout/index.md): Match reading mode to page order and device orientation, distinguishing original spreads, paired pages and zoom to establish a reading baseline for each book. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [7. ManYue bookmarks and notes: save a page and return to the right place](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-page-bookmarks/index.md): Bookmark reference pages and add short notes, distinguish bookmarks from history and favourites, and check position limits when chapters change. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [8. Prepare ManYue for offline reading: check the whole comic before leaving](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-offline-preflight/index.md): Check beginning, middle and end pages, chapter changes, reopening and disconnected access to distinguish local copies from remote covers and build a verified travel list. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [9. ManYue downloads: manage the queue, retry failures and verify local copies](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-download-queue/index.md): Distinguish queued, downloading, complete and failed states, use pause, resume and retry separately, and do not assume clearing a task record guarantees a file is deleted or retained. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [10. Connect ManYue to WebDAV: check the address, library and downloads](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-webdav-library/index.md): Access your comics through a private WebDAV service, distinguish file libraries from data sync, and check folder permissions, library scope and offline copies. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [11. Connect ManYue to SMB: browse NAS comics and keep offline copies](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-smb-library/index.md): Check the SMB host, share name and account permissions, choose a library folder and verify access, then establish what remains available outside the local network. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [12. Connect ManYue to Komga: permissions, series, books and offline checks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-komga-library/index.md): Use your Komga address and account, understand how series and books appear, and verify catalogue access, page-by-page reading and downloads separately. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [13. Connect ManYue to Kavita: sign in and check library permissions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-kavita-library/index.md): Enter the address and account for the Kavita service, check shared libraries, chapters and download permissions, and avoid copying another client’s connection method without checking it. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [14. ManYue OPDS connections: why a catalogue may not support page streaming](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-opds-pse-library/index.md): Distinguish OPDS catalogues, whole-file acquisition links and OPDS-PSE page streams, enter the correct catalogue URL and choose a reading or local-import route you can verify. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [15. Troubleshoot ManYue servers: separate network, login, catalogue and page access](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-server-connection-troubleshooting/index.md): Use a known sample to locate the failing stage in WebDAV, SMB, Komga, Kavita or OPDS, and keep error information that can be checked again. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [16. ManYue iCloud sync: move reading progress and shelves to another device](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-icloud-sync/index.md): Confirm the source device’s data, set up automatic or manual iCloud sync, and compare one reading position and one shelf group across both devices. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [17. ManYue WebDAV data sync: use a dedicated folder and choose the first direction](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-webdav-sync/index.md): Sync reading history and favourites through your own WebDAV folder, choose the initial upload or download direction, check the last success time and keep comic-file libraries separate. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [18. Move ManYue to another device: restore reading state, then comic files](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-device-migration/index.md): Divide migration into app data, local comics, server connections and offline checks, and verify each before deciding whether to clear the old device. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [19. ManYue manual backup and restore: keep app data and comic originals separately](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-backup-and-restore/index.md): Follow app-data export through post-restore checks, identifying the saved state, potentially sensitive information and comic files that need their own backup. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [20. ManYue storage cleanup: distinguish caches, copies, download tasks and shelves](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-storage-cleanup/index.md): Confirm which offline content and originals to keep, then clean caches, task records or comic copies by type instead of deleting files to organise shelves. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [21. ManYue Wi-Fi import: upload a comic from a computer browser](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-wifi-import/index.md): Upload one comic through ManYue’s Wi-Fi import page, check pairing, the target group, upload and parsing results, then verify local reading. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [22. Import ManYue sources: JS files, ManYue files and subscription URLs](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-source-import/index.md): Distinguish JS and ManYue source files, single-source URLs and source lists. Add a small set, verify browsing, search and reading, and keep the maintenance source. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [23. Maintain ManYue sources: updates, search scope and access failures](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-source-maintenance/index.md): Check source versions and failure stages, adjust participation in combined search, and handle login, removal and re-adding carefully where reading records are linked. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [24. ManYue combined search: compare results from your added sources](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-cross-source-search/index.md): Limit combined search to two working sources, compare author, edition and chapter details, then verify individual-source results rather than assuming matching titles are the same edition. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [25. Follow updates in ManYue: build a list for ongoing reading](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-follow-updates/index.md): Add one serial comic to the update-following list, check update requests, unread status, group following and stopping, and distinguish no updates from a failed check. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [26. ManYue Read Later: organise a short to-read list](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-read-later/index.md): Build a three-title plan with Read Later, checking add, filter, resume and remove actions while distinguishing favourites, update following and offline downloads. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [27. ManYue reading history: find the last title and position](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-reading-history/index.md): Use history and Continue Reading to recover a chapter position, distinguish removing a resume entry, deleting history and deleting a local file, and handle position changes when sources change. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [28. Search ManYue chapters: find volume names and chapter numbers](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-chapter-search/index.md): Narrow a long contents list by title, chapter number or volume, check ambiguous numbers, sorting and jump results, and keep a reliable reading position. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [29. Hide and restore in ManYue: tidy the library and retain reading records](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-hide-restore/index.md): Use hide and restore in ManYue 2.0.2, verify files and reading records remain, and distinguish hiding, removing from Continue Reading, clearing history and deleting local copies. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [30. ManYue image favourites: save pages and revisit them by title](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-image-favorites/index.md): Favourite two reader pages, then find them by work, search or time. Distinguish image favourites, page bookmarks and saving to Photos. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [31. Connect ManYue to Suwayomi: browse server libraries and chapters](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-suwayomi-library/index.md): Connect an existing Suwayomi / Tachidesk library, check chapters and progress, and distinguish server downloads, local offline files and connection identity after a server move. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [32. Connect ManYue to LANraragi: archives, tags and a personal comic library](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-lanraragi-library/index.md): Use the native LANraragi connection, check the API key, archive-to-chapter mapping, tag search and page indexes, and establish the scope of local progress and offline downloads. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [33. ManYue multiple servers: distinguish matching titles and personal library scope](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-server-library-scope/index.md): Name connections, filter by source and choose all books or only My Comics, then check edition identity and offline content across server libraries. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [34. Read PDF comics in ManYue: covers, wide pages and reading position](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-pdf-reading/index.md): Import and check a PDF comic’s cover, page order, landscape spreads, zoom quality and resume position, distinguishing fixed pages from text-layout features. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [35. Read vertical comics in ManYue: continuous scrolling and page joins](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-long-strip-reading/index.md): Choose continuous vertical mode for long-strip comics and check seams, side margins, wide images and restored position while preserving the original order and pace. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [36. ManYue reader controls: page taps and zoom gestures](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-reader-shortcuts/index.md): Establish tap-to-turn, reverse-tap, zoom and menu gestures on iPhone or iPad, then check quick-favourite conflicts and the scope of each setting. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [37. ManYue appearance: dark mode, backgrounds and screen display](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-reading-appearance/index.md): Adjust the app theme and reader display separately. Use a grayscale sample to check night dimming, background and system brightness together without losing image detail. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [38. ManYue batch export: keep downloaded comics as manageable files](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-batch-export/index.md): Export local comics to CBZ or PDF in batches, check the ZIP container, save location and page completeness, and distinguish comic-file archives from reading-data backups. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [39. ManYue reading statistics: total time and records by title](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-reading-statistics/index.md): Review total reading time, today, the last seven days and per-title records. Understand what counts as reading, and distinguish statistics from history cleanup and device screen time. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [40. ManYue progress trackers: connect Bangumi or MyAnimeList and verify matches](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue-reading-trackers/index.md): Connect Bangumi or MyAnimeList, verify each title match, remote-progress import and manual sync, then decide whether to enable automatic updates. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
